_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although cash generated by KMP’s assets is predominantly fee based and is generally not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and NGL. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY12-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.0%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.4-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +105.4%/yr (FY12-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +105.4%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY12-FY13: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2014-05-16) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.00x (1.3% downside to Bear $33 / +775.9% upside to Bull $293) | Adj composite 2.95 vs market 1.22: gap +1.73 [UNDERVALUED] | +4% above the EPP floor $32 (28x FY14E $1.15) | Conservative 2-yr case: +55.1% total (+27.6%/yr) | At 29.1x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $44 sits at or below the BASE case; segment EBDA +5.6% and Natural Gas Pipelines +19.1% in Q1 2014, forward revenues +32.3% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2014 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
